F1: canView(ClientModel)` returns true as soon as the all-clients `view` check in `canView()` passes, and `ClientsResource.getClients()` uses that same result, so a deny policy on one client can never block viewing it (users and client `manage` don't have this problem).
F2: canView()` checks only the all-clients `view` scope, so an admin with only all-clients `manage` can create client scopes but gets 403 from `getClientScopes`, or an empty list if they hold `query-clients`; meanwhile `canView(ClientScopeModel)` does accept `manage`.
